question.text: The concept of Place of Effective Management (POEM) is used to determine the residential status of which type of entity?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Indian income-tax law (Section 6(3) of the Income Tax Act), Place of Effective Management (POEM) is specifically used to determine the residential status of a company. A company is a resident in India in any previous year if it is an Indian company or if its POEM, in that year, is in India — in which case it is taxable on its worldwide income. Residential status of an individual is determined by day-count tests (physical presence in India), not POEM; an HUF's residence depends on the control and management of its affairs; and an AOP also has its own control-and-management-based test, not POEM. The Trap: Because POEM is partly about "management decisions", it can sound like it should apply to HUFs or AOPs (where the karta or principal officer takes decisions) — but the statutory POEM test is reserved for companies. Note: The explicit use of POEM for determining a company's residential status is not stated on the NISM Series X-B Investment Adviser Level 2 workbook pages checked; the framing above reflects Section 6(3) of the Indian Income Tax Act and CBDT POEM guidelines rather than a workbook citation.
